inputs.volume_unit: mm^3 as labelled by publisher; not independently recomputed
inputs.missing_value_policy: No global imputation; training-fold median after log1p
inputs.selection: strict M0, positive follow-up, no blocking outcome/surgery flags

configuration.aggregation: Harrell: within-fold pairs; IPCW: equal-fold mean; paired differences per repeat
configuration.sensitivity: exclude death_gap patients, retaining primary fold assignments
